description: This file contains Swift source code for testing the GatewayChannelActor, specifically focusing on WebSocket connection behaviors such as concurrent connection handling, failure scenarios, and authentication errors. It defines test cases using a mock WebSocket session and various response scenarios.

classes.name: GatewayChannelConnectTests
classes.description: A struct containing test cases for the GatewayChannelActor's connection logic, including handling concurrent connections, failure responses, and structured authentication errors.

methods.name: makeSession
methods.description: Creates a mock WebSocket session configured with specified response behavior for testing connection scenarios.

methods.name: concurrent connect is single flight on success
methods.description: Test to ensure multiple concurrent connect attempts result in a single WebSocket connection when the response is successful.

methods.name: concurrent connect shares failure
methods.description: Test to verify that multiple concurrent connect attempts share the same failure response when the WebSocket connection fails.

methods.name: connect surfaces structured auth failure
methods.description: Test validating that structured authentication failure responses are correctly surfaced as errors with detailed info.
